scope: Consumed development evaluation ONLY. This inventory never enters classifier training, support derivation, routing, probability extraction, prediction, or fresh selection. New training must exclude every consumed evaluation formula/label and historical aliases.

no_extra_completion_constraint.false_rejections: candidate>=signed preserves every signed false rejection. No-worse count plus no-new-case gates therefore require accepting every actual<=cap,signed<=cap case; all62 required targets are in that set if rejected.
no_extra_completion_constraint.false_acceptances: candidate<=release preserves every release false acceptance. No-worse count plus no-new-case gates therefore require rejecting every actual>cap,release>cap case; all38 required negatives satisfy release>cap and are repairable within the bounds.
no_extra_completion_constraint.baseline_errors: Actual>cap with release<=cap, or actual<=cap with signed>cap, are not required to be repaired and remain disclosed separately.
